item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when's three parts hold at head: the gate command is green (1731 passed, 5 skipped, EXIT=0, reproduced), test_candidate_judgment.py shows one route_ids and one judge_candidates call adding their reported cost under candidate_route/candidate_judgment and test_discover_map.py shows the cost limit still halting the loop, and grep -n "_capture_decisions_cost|candidates.call_decisions =" imas_codex/ finds nothing (exit 1) where the same grep at base finds five hits.

item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the commit, both gate commands and results, test_logs, the negative control and its note, and the CANDIDATE_route/jeval step-name decision, but its baseline_suite and after_suite fields are empty (FINDING at manifest.md:19).
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares five paths and git show --stat 9e37b70ab lists exactly those five files; the done-when names four code/test paths and the fifth is the docs/evidence fragment the graphics convention requires.

justifications.durability: the declared mutation (dropping the cost=cost hookup in judge_candidates) reddens exactly test_judge_candidates_adds_reported_cost_to_the_pipeline_cost with KeyError: 'candidate_judgment' and leaves the other 15 tests passing (gate-negative-control.log, EXIT=1), and the cost-limit test now drives the real budget path instead of substituting the deleted seam, closing the untested-wrapper finding section 7 recorded.
justifications.evidence: the reviewed run's gate-head.log records 1731 passed, 5 skipped, 1 deselected, EXIT=0 and the negative control records 1 failed, 15 passed, EXIT=1; I reproduced the head arm at 9e37b70ab in a scratch tree (1731 passed, EXIT=0, head-arm.log) and measured the base arm at 1325b8d5 (1729 passed, EXIT=0, base-arm.log), so both arms are readable even though the manifest's armed fields are null (FINDING at manifest.md:19).
justifications.fit: the optional cost: PipelineCost | None = None mirrors the map pipeline's _acall_llm(..., cost=...) idiom section 10 cites, the TYPE_CHECKING import of PipelineCost keeps candidates.py free of a runtime import cycle, and the diff carries no plan, ticket or attribution string.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/ids/candidates.py:306 route_ids and :379 judge_candidates each take a cost keyword and delegate to _call_judgment (:265), which adds the transport's reported spend at :292 under the step names set at :341 and :422; imas_codex/ids/workers.py passes state.cost at both call sites and no longer defines or assigns the module attribute, exactly section 10's three bullets.
justifications.reuse: the change extends the shared _call_judgment/call_decisions layer and the existing PipelineCost type from imas_codex/ids/mapping.py rather than adding a second tracker or client, and it deletes the global-mutation contextmanager rather than duplicating its effect.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --stat 9e37b70ab lists exactly the five paths the manifest declares and no other file changed, the plan's four code/test write paths among them; the evidence fragment is the only non-code path and is the declared docs/evidence artifact.
